name: # Message declaration parity: both shapes of main.msg build in both
# implementations and serialize to the same bytes. The declared shape is a
# flat entry keyed by message name, with the pattern as data (an ordered list
# of single-pair maps) and the metadata as declared fields; the legacy shape
# nests the pattern pairs, so the pattern is the path to the definition. Rows
# pass the built-in msg checks too - the parity runners wire the msg producer
# ahead of the model producer, as the Model does.
declared-shape
legacy-chain
mixed-shapes
